versions.changelog:
Initial release of the mp-tdd skill.

- Provides a clear, opinionated workflow for test-driven development (TDD) using a red-green-refactor loop.
- Emphasizes writing tests for actual user-facing behavior, discourages bulk/horizontal test writing.
- Recommends incremental development via tracer bullets (one test, one implementation at a time).
- Includes checklists and prompts for planning, designing for testability, and user confirmation.
- Offers guidance for effective refactoring after tests pass.
- Strong focus on practicality: test behaviors that matter, not low-value implementation details.
